tagging_basis: OCR H432 numbered specification sections (lettered learning outcomes as evidence)

units.summary: Identify which of four molecules is polar from its shape and bond polarity.
units.difficulty_basis: Single-step recall of polarity and shape

units.summary: Recall the formula of silver carbonate from ionic charges.
Choose the statement explaining why ice is less dense than water.
units.difficulty_basis: Standard recall of hydrogen bonding in ice

units.summary: Identify the Group 2 compound unsuitable as a soil neutraliser or antacid.
units.difficulty_basis: Recall of uses; insoluble sulfate is a known exception

units.summary: Identify the p-block element whose atoms have one unpaired electron.
Decide which species is oxidised or reduced from an unfamiliar redox equation.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs oxidation numbers in unfamiliar oxychloride

units.summary: Deduce the formula of the ferrate(VI) ion from its oxidation state and charge.
units.difficulty_basis: Oxidation number reasoning on unfamiliar ion

units.summary: Balance the equation for copper with concentrated nitric acid and give moles of acid used.
Deduce the formula of a gaseous product from reacting gas volumes at constant conditions.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs gas volume ratios and atom balance

units.summary: Find which sample contains the most molecules from masses of four substances.
Calculate the O-H bond enthalpy from an enthalpy of reaction and other bond enthalpies.
units.difficulty_basis: Standard bond enthalpy calculation with stoichiometry

units.summary: Choose conditions giving greatest equilibrium yield of hydrogen for an endothermic reaction.
Calculate Kc from equilibrium concentrations for a 2SO2 + O2 system.
units.difficulty_basis: Expression plus numerical substitution with powers

units.summary: Compare two displayed structures in terms of empirical formula, Mr, isomerism and functional groups.
Identify the property explaining the low reactivity of alkanes.
Choose reagents converting a secondary alcohol to a bromoalkane.
Identify the compound that can both be oxidised by dichromate and dehydrated by acid.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs alcohol classification applied to several structures

units.summary: Calculate percentage yield of an alcohol from the mass of bromobutane used.
Identify the row correctly describing a nucleophile.
Identify the carboxylic acid from molecular ion and fragment peaks in a mass spectrum.
units.difficulty_basis: Interpret m/z and fragments across four structures

units.label: 21(a)
units.summary: State the number of electrons that fill the first four shells.

units.label: 21(b)
units.summary: State differences and similarities in atomic structure between isotopes.

units.label: 21(c)(i)
units.summary: Calculate the relative atomic mass of chlorine from a mass spectrum to 2 decimal places.

units.label: 21(c)(ii)
units.summary: Explain the Cl2 molecular ion peak at m/z 72 and predict the other two M+ peaks.
units.difficulty_basis: Requires combining isotopes into diatomic ions

units.label: 22(a)(i)
units.summary: Complete the electron configuration of a bromine atom.

units.label: 22(a)(ii)
units.summary: Write the equation for phosphorus reacting with bromine.
units.difficulty_basis: Equation given the formula of product

units.label: 22(b)
units.summary: Name the lattice type and explain conductivity differences between solid and liquid.
units.difficulty_basis: Linking structure to conductivity in two states

units.label: 22(c)
units.summary: Determine molar mass and molecular formula of a fluoride of bromine from gas volume data using pV = nRT.
units.difficulty_basis: Unit conversions and multi-step ideal gas work

units.label: 23(a)
units.summary: Calculate the hydroxide ion concentration from mass of Ba(OH)2 in solution to 3 sf.
units.difficulty_basis: Multi-step mole and concentration with 2:1 ratio

units.label: 23(b)(i)
units.summary: State what is meant by concordant titres.

units.label: 23(b)(ii)
units.summary: Calculate the concentration of barium hydroxide from a titration mean titre.

units.label: 23(c)
units.summary: Outline two routes with equations for making Ba(OH)2 solution from barium.
units.difficulty_basis: Needs recall of reactions with water and oxygen

units.label: 24(a)
units.summary: Calculate the enthalpy of formation of ammonia from enthalpies of combustion.
units.difficulty_basis: Hess cycle with stoichiometry and sign care

units.label: 24(b)
units.summary: Explain using Boltzmann distributions how temperature and a catalyst increase rate.

units.label: 25(a)
units.summary: Draw the addition polymer repeat unit and the HBr product from propene.

units.label: 25(b)
units.summary: Draw the electrophilic addition mechanism for propene with bromine with curly arrows.
units.difficulty_basis: Full mechanism needs precise arrows and dipoles

units.label: 25(c)(i)
units.summary: Explain what is meant by a homologous series.

units.label: 25(c)(ii)
units.summary: Suggest the general formula of alkynes from a table of members.

units.label: 25(c)(iii)
units.summary: Write an equation for propyne reacting with excess bromine and show the organic product.

units.label: 25(c)(iv)
units.summary: Draw two structural isomers of C4H6 other than but-1-yne.

units.label: 25(c)(v)
units.summary: Draw the structure of 2,5-dimethylhept-3-yne.
units.difficulty_basis: Naming rules applied to unfamiliar alkyne
